SELECT OBJECT_DEFINITION(OBJECT_ID('[dbo].[stack_confirmity]')) AS ViewDefinition;

Drop VIEW dbo.rtg_ecevents
Drop VIEW dbo.rtg_workhours

create or ALTER view itv_hours_moves
as
select *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'gold/itv_hours_moves',
        data_source = 'cgsa',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
    ) AS [itv_hours_moves];

create or ALTER view itv_productivity
as
select *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'gold/itv_productivity',
        data_source = 'cgsa',
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
    ) AS [itv_productivity];
